items.title: The font checks' contexts (text-rendering auto) share a platform font with DOM text of the same zoomed size, so check 4 depends on who came first
items.source: rebuild/probes/measure-first.ts M1 (font_description.cc:308-331: the cache key holds the effective size and text-rendering, not the specified size; font_platform_data_mac.mm:170-178); src/measure/font-checks.ts check 4
items.note: For a named font with an opsz axis at a zoom other than 1: after the DOM, the zoomed-size context gets the DOM's font, the advances look linear, the fact comes out false and the engine measures at the zoomed size with another optical size, without a gap; before the DOM, the check leaves the fact unknown and the DOM text then takes the check's font. No lab font but the system font has the axis, so no lab case shows it; the checks never measure the system font at the zoomed size. A context at text-rendering optimizeLegibility, as the engine measures, would share nothing with default-rendered DOM text.
